desc.ian_image_library:title: Cypselurus callopterus (Ornamented Flying Fish)
desc.ian_image_library:descr: Flying fish can make powerful, self-propelled leaps out of water into air, where their long, wing-like fins enable gliding flight for considerable distances above the water's surface. This uncommon ability is a natural defense mechanism to evade predators.
